summary: 19.5M for the month across 106 tokens, and the book behind it is not one lucky ticket: PONS at 134x on a 68k entry sits next to MarsCoin at 4.7x on 965k and USELESS at 4.1x on 830k. 167 buys against 71 sells with 46 entries inside ten minutes of a launch, so the negative realized flow is accumulation, not loss.

1.67M, and effectively all of it is PONS at 1117x on a 1,367-dollar entry. The other two bags are at 0.4x and 0.6x, and 8.9k of buying has produced 614 dollars of selling. A remarkable ticket; nothing else in the book supports it.

600 trades across six tokens at a two-minute median hold, buys and sells nearly matched. Enormous frequency with almost no breadth is automated market-making, not a trader with a thesis anyone could copy.
